$schema_description: Contribution template for adding or updating verified courses and certifications in data/skill_certifications.json (#757)
instructions: 1. Ensure the course or certification link is active, accessible, and reputable (e.g. Coursera, edX, freeCodeCamp, official vendor certifications).
2. Include accurate provider, difficulty level (Beginner | Intermediate | Advanced), pricing type (Free | Paid | Free to Audit), and approximate duration.
3. Set last_verified to the current date (YYYY-MM-DD) confirming the resource was checked and active.
4. To submit, add the skill key and array of up to 3 verified options into data/skill_certifications.json under the 'skills' object (or at root level). No code changes are required.
